title: 第三章 储物袋第四章 长青镇
content_zh:
从父亲书房出来后柳辰就出了郡主府，到城里的飘香楼跟林虎好好吃了一顿。
做为元南郡地位最高的一层人，修炼用的资源可能需要省着用。
但是世俗的金币银币还是不缺的，这次吃饭一共也才花了五个银币。
也多亏每位武者都是大胃王，否则一般人还真吃不完这么多菜。
满满一大桌，大部分都是肉菜，还有两坛好酒，都进了两人的肚子。
也就柳辰两人是熟人了，否则一定会被当成妖怪的。
五枚银币虽然对于柳辰来说不算什么，但是如果放到普通人家，那就不得了了。
要知道一枚银币就够普通三口之家好好生活一个月了，大部分普通人平时使用的都是铜币。
这个世界的货币分为铜、银、金三种，之间的兑换比例都是一比一百。
除了普通货币外还有就是修炼者们使用的灵石，当然这是只在武者以及修士之间流通的货币，分为下品、中品、上品以及极品四种品级。
柳辰虽然不缺金银，但是灵石这类修炼资源还是很缺少的，每个月只能领到两块低品灵石用于修炼。
刨出修炼用度，这些年也就攒了十块，突破低级武徒时阵法消耗了五块，所以现在身上就只剩下五块了。
所以从某些方面讲柳辰也很穷。
跟林虎吃完饭回来中间还发生了一个插曲，遇到了现在的郡主夫人。
当然这个郡主夫人不是柳辰的母亲，是柳镇南续的弦，柳辰的母亲在柳辰五岁的时候就因故去世了。
后来柳镇南娶了现在的夫人李香兰，并且同样生育了一子。
柳辰也没有怪父亲，柳镇南在上层圈子里算是专情的了，其他的贵族大人们哪个不是妻妾成群。
武者世家更是这样，家族想要壮大就少不了资质出色的家族成员，柳家在武者世家里算是人丁比较凋零的了。
虽然柳辰不介意父亲续弦，但是这个郡主夫人却不怎么待见柳辰。
柳辰也知道是怎么回事，无非是自己的存在，挡了他的儿子，自己的那个弟弟接未来郡主的位子了。

柳辰也不在意，只是一来二去相互之间交流就少了，哪怕见面也只是简单点头或问候一下而已。
这次柳辰去元妖山脉一是为了提升实战经验，还有一方面原因就是父亲闭关柳辰也不想单独面对这位姨娘。
等柳辰回到自己住的地方，府里的管家林老已经在院子里等着了。
“少爷，这是少爷让我带给您的乾坤袋”
林老见柳辰回来，连忙上前把一个黑色的袋子恭敬递给柳辰。
“有劳林老了，下次不必亲自在外面等着，安排一个下人就行了，您老岁数也不小了，不用因为这么点小事就亲自跑一趟”
柳辰可以不给郡主夫人面子，但是面对这个林老还是很恭敬的。
content_en:
After coming out of his father's study, Liu Chen left the princess's mansion and went to Piaoxiang Tower in the city to have a good meal with Lin Hu.
As a person with the highest status in Yuannan County, the resources for cultivation may need to be used sparingly.
But there is still no shortage of worldly gold and silver coins. This meal only cost five silver coins in total.
It’s also thanks to the fact that every warrior is a big eater, otherwise most people would really not be able to finish so many dishes.
There was a big table full, mostly meat and vegetables, and two jars of good wine, both of which went into the stomachs of the two of them.
Only Liu Chen and Liu Chen were acquaintances, otherwise they would definitely be regarded as monsters.
Although five silver coins are nothing to Liu Chen, if they were given to ordinary people, it would be a big deal.
You must know that one silver coin is enough for an ordinary family of three to live well for a month. Most ordinary people usually use copper coins.
The currencies in this world are divided into three types: copper, silver, and gold, and the exchange ratio between them is one to one hundred.
In addition to ordinary currency, there are also spiritual stones used by cultivators. Of course, this is currency that is only circulated among warriors and monks. It is divided into four grades: low grade, medium grade, high grade and top grade.
Although Liu Chen is not short of gold and silver, he is still short of cultivation resources such as spirit stones. He can only receive two low-grade spirit stones for practice every month.
After excluding the training expenses, I have only saved ten yuan over the years. When I broke through to the low-level martial arts, I spent five yuan on the formation, so now I only have five yuan left.
So in some ways Liu Chen was also very poor.
There was an episode when I came back from dinner with Lin Hu, and I met the current princess's wife.
Of course, this princess's wife is not Liu Chen's mother, but Liu Zhennanxuan's son. Liu Chen's mother died for some reason when Liu Chen was five years old.
Later Liu Zhennan married his current wife Li Xianglan and also gave birth to a son.
Liu Chen didn't blame his father. Liu Zhennan was considered a dedicated person in the upper class circles, and all the other nobles had wives and concubines.
This is especially true for a family of warriors. If a family wants to grow, it needs family members with outstanding qualifications. The Liu family is relatively small in the family of warriors.
Although Liu Chen didn't mind his father's renewal, the princess's wife didn't like Liu Chen very much.
Liu Chen also knew what was going on. It was just his own existence that blocked his son, his younger brother, from taking over the position of the future princess.
Liu Chen didn't care, but there was less communication between them, and even when they met, they just nodded or greeted each other.
This time Liu Chen went to the Yuanyao Mountains partly to improve his actual combat experience, but also because his father was in seclusion and Liu Chen didn't want to face his aunt alone.
When Liu Chen returned to where he lived, the housekeeper Lin Lao was already waiting in the yard.
"Master, this is the Qiankun bag that the master asked me to bring to you."
When Mr. Lin saw Liu Chen coming back, he quickly stepped forward and respectfully handed a black bag to Liu Chen.
"Laurin is old. You don't have to wait outside in person next time. Just arrange a servant. You are not young anymore. There is no need to go there in person for such a trivial matter."
Liu Chen didn't have to give face to the princess and his wife, but he was still very respectful to Mr. Lin.
